dos.text: Instantiate PlacesToolbar directly against the real #PlacesToolbarItems/#PersonalToolbar markup already in the document, it's manually constructed (new PlacesToolbar(...)) by browser-places.js, not something that self-initializes from a custom element.

donts.text: Don't look elsewhere for drag-and-drop, the overflow chevron, or resize handling, PlacesToolbar (extends PlacesViewBase) is the one real place all of that lives.
